definition: Given a set with an even number of objects, the learner finds the number of objects in one of two equal groups.
distinguishing_evidence: Distinguishes taking half from subtracting 2 or doubling.

labels.en: States how many objects are in half (1/2) of a set.
labels.si: ද්‍රව්‍ය සමූහයකින් බාගයක් (1/2) ද්‍රව්‍ය කීයක් දැයි ප්‍රකාශ කරයි.

observable_success: Gives the number of objects in half of a set without seeing the grouping.
scope_note: Pilot skill for the Grade 5 Fractions slice (ADR-0006); researcher-authored draft.

definition: Given a set whose size is a multiple of 4, the learner finds the number of objects in 1/4, 2/4 or 3/4 of the set by forming four equal groups and taking the stated number of groups.
distinguishing_evidence: Separates finding one quarter from taking several quarters, dividing by the top number, and taking the remainder.

labels.en: States how many objects are in one, two or three quarters of a set.
labels.si: ද්‍රව්‍ය සමූහයකින් හතරෙන් පංගු එකක්, දෙකක් සහ තුනක් ද්‍රව්‍ය කීයක් දැයි ප්‍රකාශ කරයි.

observable_success: Gives the number of objects in 1/4 and 3/4 of a set.
scope_note: Pilot skill for the Grade 5 Fractions slice (ADR-0006); researcher-authored draft.

definition: Given a whole divided into ten equal parts, the learner names the shaded amount as a number of tenths and recognises a correct tenths representation.
distinguishing_evidence: Separates equal-part counting from part-to-part, complement and reversed naming.

labels.en: Shows tenths as parts of a whole.
labels.si: සම්පූර්ණ එකක කොටසක් වශයෙන් දහයෙන් පංගු දක්වයි.

observable_success: Names k/10 for a whole with k of ten equal parts shaded.
Chooses the shape that correctly shows a given number of tenths.
scope_note: Pilot skill for the Grade 5 Fractions slice (ADR-0006); researcher-authored draft.

definition: Given a shape divided into equal parts, the learner names the shaded half or quarters and recognises that unequal parts do not show halves or quarters.
distinguishing_evidence: Separates unequal-part acceptance from part-to-part and complement naming.

labels.en: Shows halves and quarters as parts of a whole.
labels.si: සම්පූර්ණ එකක කොටසක් වශයෙන් දෙකෙන් පංගු සහ හතරෙන් පංගු දක්වයි.

observable_success: Names 1/4 or 3/4 for a shape with that many of four equal parts shaded.
Rejects shapes with unequal parts when asked for halves or quarters.
scope_note: Pilot skill for the Grade 5 Fractions slice (ADR-0006); researcher-authored draft. The teacher guide (SRC-G5-MAT-TG-01 p.31) lists this as the first learning outcome, but the shared trace has no node for it; the ID is appended so existing IDs do not change.

definition: The learner writes a shaded number of tenths as a one-place decimal and writes a one-place decimal as a fraction with denominator 10.
distinguishing_evidence: Separates place errors (3.10, 0.04) from reading the decimal as a whole number.

labels.si: එක් දශමස්ථානයක් සහිත දශම සංඛ්‍යා දහයෙන් පංගු ලෙස දක්වයි.

scope_note: Pilot skill for the Grade 5 Fractions slice (ADR-0006); researcher-authored draft. Decimals competency G5-MAT-C05; included because the committed crosswalk maps it to MAT-FRC (Fractions & Decimals).
